title: Transition coefficients on two nonvanishing opens are reciprocal on their intersection
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal M$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let $s,t\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal M)$ and let $U,V$ be opens with underlying sets $X_s,X_t$, respectively, where $X_a=\{x:a_x\notin\mathfrak m_x\mathcal M_x\}$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There exist $f\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ and $g\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)$ such that $U\cap V=D_U(f)$ [lem-weil-pbc-basic-open-function] and $f|_{U\cap V}g|_{U\cap V}=1$ in $\Gamma(U\cap V,\mathcal O_X)$. Neither open need be affine; $X$ need not be quasi-compact.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CY (lemma-s-open); Properties, proofs of Lemma 01PV (lemma-affine-cap-s-open) and Lemma 01PY

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes] to $s$ and $t$. On $U$ and $V$ their multiplication maps from the structure sheaf are isomorphisms. The inverse maps applied to the other section give the unique coefficients $f,g$ with $t|_U=f s|_U$ and $s|_V=g t|_V$.

At $x\in U$, $s(x)$ is a basis of the residue fibre, so $t(x)=f(x)s(x)$ is nonzero exactly when $f(x)$ is nonzero. Thus $U\cap V=D_U(f)$. Both sets have no points outside $U$. This uses the basic-open residue-field criterion in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-section-vanishing-prime], locally on affine subopens of $U$, and the nonvanishing predicate [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].

Restrict the coefficient equations to $W=U\cap V$ and substitute to get $t|_W=f|_Wg|_Wt|_W$. Uniqueness of the coefficient of the generator $t|_W$ gives $f|_Wg|_W=1$. If $W$ is empty its ring is the zero ring and the equality still holds.

lean.statement: theorem exists_nonvanishing_transition_functions {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (s t : M.val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) (U V : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus M s) (hV : (V : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus M t) : ∃ (f : Γ(X, U)) (g : Γ(X, V)), U ⊓ V = X.basicOpen f ∧ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op) f * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op) g = 1
